contexts.text: Sometimes they have heat like that of a dirty bath.
I saw a bath, with long seats... SE 4024.
(The heat which exhales from some of the Hells) is like the warmth of a bath.
Christian polygamists... appear in Hell as if lying in warm water in a bath.
The heat of the marriage love of polygamists... was perceived by me as the foul heat of a bath.
(The heat of a bath felt in the forehead.) Explained.
Like the water of a bath thrown upon the shoulders...
